title: Slot-16 Fleur-de-Lis
description: A man in a white suit stands in the foreground reaching up to place a martini glass into a large glowing orb device labeled SLOT-16. The orb contains silhouettes of women drinking martinis and is topped with a central pink sphere from which four colorful glowing lines extend upward, each terminating in a dripping neon fleur-de-lis symbol in yellow, red, blue, and magenta.
prompt: Surreal pop art scene featuring a man in a white suit holding up a martini glass toward a large transparent spherical device labeled SLOT-16 on a black pedestal. Inside the orb are silhouettes of women sitting and drinking martinis. A glowing pink orb sits atop a black ornate stand in the center, with four neon glowing lines in yellow, red, blue and magenta rising from it ending in large dripping fleur-de-lis symbols. Vibrant purple background with circular patterns and colorful dripping paint effects.
